description: Heals by hurting - opens a vein in the enemy and the party drinks.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from data/reference/coa/bloodmage.json (40 real CoA Fleshweaver talents, role HEALER, 'Discipline Priest + Blood DK'). Replaces a 23-node tree with 3 procs and 19 bare numbers. Fourth and last Bloodmage spec: the class went from 11 procs across 92 nodes to 51 across 110. Four CoA talents read the live Pooled Vitality stack count, which nothing in this engine can do - the same wall Sanguine's six Thirst nodes hit. Blood Rituals is built through splash_heal, which reaches the same outcome from the other end.

nodes.name: Gift of Lana'thel
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 51% of your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your spell power by 25% of your Spirit and your hit rating by 4% of your Spirit.' The hit conversion is NOT built: hit_rating is not in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, so hit_rating_from_spirit_pct would be skipped in silence - the Clarity of the Heavens failure, and the third time this exact pairing has come up in the rebuild. Spirit is the spec's whole stat, so the spell power half doubled over CoA's two ranks is the node.

nodes.name: Consolidation
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases your haste by 5%.' Already a scalar in CoA.

nodes.name: Organ Orbs
nodes.description: Increases your healing power by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each stack of Pooled Vitality now increases your Spirit by 3%.' Nothing reads a live stack count into a stat, so this is flat - and routed to healing power rather than Spirit, because Gift of Lana'thel at tier 0 already converts Spirit and stacking both would be the same point twice. healing_power_pct takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Heart Rupturer
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Claw Sweep, Sanguine Rupture, Ravenous Strike and Bloodmoon Blast by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. A healer tree with a damage node is the point of this spec: Blood Rituals turns that damage into healing, so raising it raises both.

nodes.name: Blood Redistribution
nodes.description: Increases the healing done by Fleshcraft by 12%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the maximum health restored by Fleshcraft by 25%.' ability_*_healing is the key a heal reads - for a long time only _damage was looked up, which silently broke every talent authored the correct way, so both work now and _healing is the name that belongs here.

nodes.name: Dark Liturgy
nodes.description: Bloodmoon Blast and Bloodbolt spill 25% of their damage onto up to 4 allies as healing.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Form a blood bond, healing a friendly target and applying Blood Rituals to them, bouncing to up to 10 nearby allies. Blood Rituals: Causes Bloodmoon Blast to heal marked allies.' THIS IS THE SPEC'S THESIS and the old tree had no form of it. Marking an ally and reading the mark back is not possible, so it is built as leech_pct with smart:true - the damage heals the worst-off ally - which is the same outcome CoA describes by a route that fires. smart:true is what sends it to an ALLY rather than the caster; without it this would be a self-heal, which is Sanguine's Hematoma, not this.

nodes.name: Spice of Life
nodes.description: Your periodic spells return 8 Rage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your periodic damage and healing now has a 10% chance to grant a stack of Pooled Vitality.' Pooled Vitality is not a resource Frontier has - the class's secondary is Vitality, which is CoA's Thirst, a different thing - so the grant becomes Rage, which this spec's heals actually cost. on_damage_or_heal_cast is the one trigger that catches both halves of 'periodic damage and healing', which is why Crimson Tide and Hemoglobe are in the same filter.

nodes.name: Dissipation
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Fleshcraft by up to 51%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Reduces the cooldown of Fleshcraft and the duration of the Sated debuff by -60 sec.' Sated does not exist in Frontier. Expressed as a percentage because cooldowns are counted in turns here. POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Sanguine Scion
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Sanguine Mend and Bloodbolt by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. One heal and one damage spell in the same node, which is this spec in miniature.

nodes.name: Raging Hunger
nodes.description: Your heals return 5 Rage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Triggering Pooled Vitality now also generates 3 Rage.' Pooled Vitality does not exist here, so the trigger becomes healing - which is what was generating it in CoA. This and Spice of Life are the spec's two Rage sources, deliberately split across healing and periodic damage so a Fleshweaver has to do both.

nodes.name: Dark Essence
nodes.description: Crimson Tide washes healing over up to 5 allies.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Cursed Form abilities or Bloodbolt will now heal allies affected by Blood Rituals.' The second Blood Rituals node, pointed at Crimson Tide rather than repeating Dark Liturgy's filter - Crimson Tide is this spec's area bleed, so healing off it is what makes the spec's AoE rotation also its group healing. smart:true again, so it reaches an ally.

nodes.name: Excess Blood
nodes.description: Your heals have a 10% chance to leave the target mending for 2 more turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your healing done now has a 10% chance to heal the target for an additional 240 + 3% healing over 6 seconds.' CoA's 10% kept; 6 sec is 2 turns. A proc-applied hot takes a flat potency - there is no percentage-of-the-triggering-heal form for apply_effect, unlike shield_pct and splash_heal.

nodes.name: Universal Donor
nodes.description: Vampyr's Kiss makes everyone receive 6% more healing for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Infuse or Vampyr's Kiss now increases the healing received by all allies by 6% for 10 sec.' Infuse does not exist in Frontier. 'All allies' has no mechanism - apply_effect lands on the caster or the trigger's target, not on a party - so the buff is self-only and the description says 'everyone' as the flavour it is. healing_taken_pct is percentage POINTS inside a status effect, which is the opposite of the same key as a talent effect, where Eternal Resolve writes 0.15 for 15%.

nodes.name: Black Heart
nodes.description: Vampyr's Kiss returns 20 Rage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Your Vampyr's Kiss now regenerates 20% of your maximum Rage.' Max Rage is a hardcoded 100, so 20% of it is a flat 20 - which is the one case in this rebuild where a percentage of a resource pool translates exactly, because the pool is fixed.

nodes.name: Flesh Foundry
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 15% of your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your critical strikes now reduce the cooldown of Fleshcraft and the duration of Sated on the target by 4 sec. In addition, increases your critical strike rating by 15% of your Spirit.' The conversion half is live - crit_chance_spell is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and spirit is a source - and is the half worth having on a Spirit-stacking healer. The cooldown rider would need a second proc; Dissipation at tier 1 already shortens Fleshcraft.

nodes.name: Vampyr's Kiss
nodes.description: Vampyr's Kiss leaves the target bleeding for 5 turns and taking 24% more damage over time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Curse an enemy, causing them to bleed over 30 sec. All periodic damage dealt to an enemy affected by Vampyr's Kiss is replicated on them equal to 25% of the value.' Frontier has the ability. The REPLICATION cannot be built as written - no key reads whether a target carries a debuff, so 'periodic damage against a marked enemy is amplified' becomes a flat dot_damage bonus, which is the same arithmetic without the condition. 30 sec is 10 turns, cut to 5 so it has to be reapplied.

nodes.name: Waves of Blood
nodes.description: Crimson Tide has a 10% chance to heal an ally for a quarter of its damage.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Each tick of Crimson Tide now has a 10% chance to heal a nearby ally for 25% of the damage dealt.' PER TICK is not reachable - no periodic trigger exists - so the roll happens on the cast. CoA's 10% and 25% both kept, and smart:true sends it to an ally as CoA specifies.

nodes.name: Crimson Scion
nodes.description: Your damage has a 10% chance to make your next heals 25% stronger for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct damage dealt now has a 10% chance to make your next Sanguine Mend within 10 sec instant cast.' There are no cast times, so making something instant is worth nothing. Repriced as healing done over the same window - healing_done_pct is the status-effect route to a healing multiplier, the mirror of damage_dealt_pct, and it takes percentage POINTS. CoA's 10% chance kept.

nodes.name: Lingering Essence
nodes.description: Your periodic spells have a 50% chance to bring Vampyr's Kiss a turn closer to ready.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Periodic damage and healing done now has a 50% chance to reduce the cooldown of Vampyr's Kiss by -1 sec.' Ports almost exactly - CoA's 50%, one second is one turn, and on_damage_or_heal_cast catches both halves.

nodes.name: Gruesome Rituals
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 6% and all healing you do by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your damage dealt is now increased by 1% for each stack of Pooled Vitality.' Ten stacks is 10%, granted flat because nothing reads a live stack count - and paired with the same number on healing, because on this spec they are the same thing: every Blood Rituals node turns damage into healing, so a damage-only node would be half a talent.

nodes.name: Acquired Taste
nodes.description: Vampyr's Kiss and Crimson Tide shield you for 30% of their damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Infuse or Vampyr's Kiss now generates 2 additional stacks of Pooled Vitality.' Pooled Vitality does not exist and Infuse does not either. Rebuilt as an absorb off the two abilities CoA pairs here, which is what banking vitality was FOR - this is a healer standing in melee range to apply bleeds, and it needs something back for it. Also carries CoA's Aortic Aegis ('your Blood Veil now applies to the party members of the target'), which needs a buff to spread from one ally to their party - apply_effect lands on one target and nothing fans it out, and splash_heal spreads healing rather than a buff.

nodes.name: Arterial Bind
nodes.description: Your heals spill 20% of their value onto up to 4 more allies.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Place a pool of blood on the ground, instantly silencing all enemies for 4 seconds and healing allies every 1 sec for 4 seconds.' Ground targeting and the silence are both gone - no positioning, and a blanket silence is not a payload. What survives is the group healing, built as splash off this spec's own heals. THIS is splash_heal rather than leech_pct, because it spreads a HEAL rather than converting damage - the two sit side by side in this tree and size themselves off different things.

nodes.name: Dark Blood
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your heals by up to 30%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Reduces the cost of your abilities that require Cursed Form and increases the healing done by Blood Rituals by 25%.' Cursed Form is a buff with no 'requires' gate for an effect key, and Blood Rituals in this tree is a set of procs rather than an ability with healing to raise. Pointed at the heals themselves, which cost Rage on this spec. heal_cost_pct is the alias of healing_spell_cost_pct; POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: Vitality For Later
nodes.description: Your critical heals wash over your most wounded ally for 40% of the value.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Consuming Pooled Vitality now heals up to 10 allies within 30 yds.' Consuming a caster's own stacks is not reachable - consumes_stacks_of reads them but only extends a DoT's duration, and these are heals - so the trigger becomes a critical heal, which is the closest thing to a payoff moment this spec has. smart_heal_pct is a PERCENT, divided by 100 at read time, unlike the splash_heal and leech_pct fractions elsewhere in this tree.

nodes.name: Sovereignty
nodes.description: Crimson Tide makes your next spells 15% stronger for 3 turns, stacking 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Crimson Tide now grants you Sovereignty. Sovereignty: Reduces the cost of your next Bloodbolt within 12 sec by 10% and causes it to strike 1 additional nearby enemy for each target damaged, stacking up to 5 times.' Neither half is buildable - a status effect cannot reach an ability cost key, and nothing adds targets to an ability - so the stacks pay out as damage. CoA's 5 stacks kept, which is the part that makes it feel like Sovereignty rather than a flat buff.

nodes.name: Hemal Excision
nodes.description: Your heals cleanse the target and shield them for 35% of the healing done.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Cut into an ally's vital essence, siphoning all curse effects from them. You may reactivate this ability again within 10 seconds to place these curse effects on an enemy.' Moving a debuff from an ally to an enemy is not a payload this engine has - dispel removes, it does not transfer - so the cleanse half is flavour in the description and the mechanic is an absorb, which is what a Discipline-Priest-shaped healer wants at this depth. shield_pct sizes from the triggering heal.

nodes.name: Infuse
nodes.description: Increases the damage your damage-over-time effects deal by 24% and your healing power by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Accumulates 10% of all damage dealt to the target and unleashes it after 10 seconds, dealing Shadow damage and absorbing healing done to the target equal to the damage done.' A delayed accumulator is not a shape this engine has - nothing banks damage against a target and detonates it on a timer - and Frontier has no bloodmage_infuse ability either. Rebuilt as the two stats the talent is for: periodic damage, and the healing it turns into. healing_power_pct takes percentage POINTS.

nodes.name: Blood Rituals
nodes.description: Every spell you cast feeds the party - damage spills 30% onto your most wounded ally as healing, and heals spill 30% onto four more.
nodes._source: The capstone, and the only node in the game that pairs leech_pct and splash_heal off one trigger. on_damage_or_heal_cast catches both halves, so a damage spell drains into the worst-off ally and a heal spreads to four more - which is CoA's Blood Rituals in full, the mark that makes damage heal, finally without needing a mark at all. Named for it because the three earlier nodes that carry pieces of the mechanic (Dark Liturgy, Dark Essence, Waves of Blood) each only reach one ability; this reaches everything. NOTE the two payloads size from different things: leech_pct takes the damage amount, splash_heal takes the heal amount, and on a turn that does both they both fire.

nodes.name: Hemorrhagic Shock
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
